name: Desk Name Plate
author: Jonesie
notes:
A desk name wedge in three prints, no glue: a face plate and two triangular ends that lock into one rigid wedge at 40°.

**Printing**
- Print the face plate flat, text up, no supports. It is the whole reason this is split, so the name and title get a flat, crisp surface.
- The two triangular ends are laid on their outer faces (slot side up), so the slot is open to the top.
- The lip over the slot is a 40° overhang, so print with supports there or a slightly slow bridge.

**Assembly**
- Slide the plate down into the slots from the top edge until it stops on the bottom of the slots. It sits ~1 mm below the ends' slope, held by a lip over each edge.
- The two ends and plate lock into one rigid wedge at 40°. It is a snug fit; lift it back out the same way to swap the text.
